boundary: An inspection records what was observed about a source's metadata and its published document. Retrieving a document and finding a quoted passage show only that the passage is still published; they do not show that a claim is correct or current. This log never changes a source's status, access date or any claim, and no inspection here is a human scientific review.

state_definitions.metadata_validated: The local registry record passed the structural checks (dates, URL, scope fields)
state_definitions.source_retrieved: The canonical document, or a listed page of it, was fetched with a 2xx response and a non-empty body
state_definitions.source_content_compared: Every passage that release findings quote from the source was searched for in the retrieved text
state_definitions.source_changed: A material change in the source was identified and documented
state_definitions.source_inaccessible: Retrieval was attempted and failed or was refused
state_definitions.review_required: A person must examine a specific recorded issue before the source supports an updated claim
state_definitions.not_checked: No retrieval was attempted in this run

runs.method: Metadata checks on every registry record. Retrieval of each canonical URL (and listed pages of multi-page documents) with a declared, honest user agent; one attempt per URL, no browser impersonation. Text extracted from HTML, or from PDF in reading-order and layout modes, and searched for every passage quoted by release findings, with recorded fallbacks for hyphenation and typographic marks.

Same method as the 2026-11-10 run. Passages are now also taken from the conflict register and the IDE-009 reconciliation record, so register and reconciliation quotes are checked against the retrieved documents.
